entities.summary: Devaki Pandit is an Indian classical singer. She is a disciple of Pandit Padma Vibhushan Gansaraswati Kishori Amonkar and Padma Shri Jitendra Abhisheki.￼ He worked with renowned artists like Hridaynath Mangeshkar, Ustad Raees Khan, Gulzar, Vishal Bhardwaj, Naushad, Jaydev, Jatin-Lalit, Ustad Zakir Hussain in the fields of film, television and live classical performances.
